limits: Photographic approximation, not calibrated real finish values

Complete portal gray canopy soffit/top/rear and sidewall rear caps, right-end brick opening reveals, and planter right cap. Direct official front/right photos and visitor entrance photo support brick and gray component families; exact hidden returns are continuity inference. Architect describes greenwalls and opposite indoor photo shows extensive windows, so incomplete large rear/left facade proxies remain neutral instead of solid brick. Five original screen bars span incompatible red and dark systems and remain neutral; no splitting, added geometry, decals or equipment. Original colored faces and RGBA/roughness preserved. Capture dates unverified; not a 2026-condition survey
No actual trial print; original partial-model QA caveats remain
